lines.text: Jesus asks Peter three times if he loves Him and tells him to feed His lambs and sheep.
Peter is deeply hurt by the third question and answers that Jesus knows all things.
Jesus says someone else will dress old Peter, then tells him to worship Him.
Peter asks Jesus about the disciple whom Jesus loved, and a rumor spreads that he would not marry.
The disciple whom Jesus loved testifies to these things and wrote them down, and his testimony is true.
